Game Overview

In Taxi Town, the core idea is straightforward: navigate the bustling streets of Taxi Town, where you're the city's most trusted taxi driver. Master swift navigation and timing to keep passengers smiling. Earn more tips to upgrade your ride, ensuring smoother and livelier drives. Experience vibrant city life through fun-filled mini-adventures with every trip!

Taxi Town keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Navigate the bustling streets of Taxi Town, where you're the city's most trusted taxi driver!
